text:
alice: quick experiment: compared paged-fusion vs fused-attn across L40s / A100 / H100. seq sweep [64,512,2048], bsz [1,4,32]. weird anomaly at seq=2048 bsz=32 on A100
ben: can you paste the perf-bot run summary and the kernel selection logs?
alice: perf-bot run id 2934567890 — config: --model=gpt-like --kernels=paged-fusion,fused-attn --precision=fp16 --seq=[64,512,2048] --bsz=[1,4,32] --warmup=50 --iters=200 --profile=on
perf-bot: automated summary: A100: fused-attn best at seq<=512; paged-fusion best at seq=2048 when bsz>=8. H100: similar but smaller delta. L40s: paged-fusion shows ~1.9x throughput vs fused-attn at seq=2048 bsz=32. Noted increased memcpy activity on fused-attn for long sequences on A100.
carla: that L40s win is surprising — are we sure it's not cache-alignment or tiling differences?
dmitri: @carla might be split-K / tile-size defaults. also check KV cache behavior: eviction count and prefix cache hits.
alice: pasted small profiler snippet (trimmed):
```
PROFILER TRACE: gpu=A100, seq=2048, bsz=32, kernel=fused-attn
  memcpy_htod: 48.2ms
  kernel_attn: 120.5ms
  kv_cache_evictions: 14 (spikes at iter 12,47,103)
  host_mem_barrier: 10.1ms
```
```
PROFILER TRACE: gpu=L40s, seq=2048, bsz=32, kernel=paged-fusion
  memcpy_htod: 12.4ms
  kernel_attn: 98.6ms
  kv_cache_evictions: 0
  prefetch_hits: high
```

ben: memcpy_hotspot on A100 fused-attn looks real. could be our fused kernel doing extra host-device transfers for large KV pages.
carla: hypothesis: batch-tailwind heuristic is packing mixed seqs aggressively on L40s (good) but on A100 it's triggering a fallback path that forces host copies. we should check kernel fallback logs.
dmitri: try toggling the batch policy: REDWOOD_BATCH_POLICY=conservative to avoid aggressive packing and trigger different kernel selector path. also enable KVCACHE_PREFETCH=0 to see effect.
alice: started a controlled retest with conservative policy (run id 2934567920). perf-bot: run 2934567920 — results: A100 fused-attn latency at seq2048 bsz32 improved by 18% (memcpy reduced), throughput down ~10%. kv_evictions dropped to 2.
perf-bot: note: kernel-selector took fallback->paged-fusion for some batches on A100 when conservative policy used.
ben: interesting tradeoff: conservative batching reduces memcpy but lowers throughput. L40s still prefers paged-fusion for long seqs.
carla: takeaways: (1) paged-fusion good for long seqs/large bsz on L40s; (2) fused-attn on A100 can hit host memcpy path under aggressive packing/mixed-seq — need to patch selector heuristics to penalize host copies; (3) add microbench to reproduce memcpy hotspot deterministically.
dmitri: agreed. action items: open kernel-team bug with profiler snippet + kernel fallback logs; add microbench in perf-harness that forces mixed-seq packing; tune batch-tailwind weight to include estimated memcpy cost for the GPU device profile.
alice: I'll open the PR and attach the microbench tests. tagging @dmitri for kernel-team follow-up. :thumbsup:
